endpoints.type:
@Writer.writer_tell_appends
     : forall (W : Type) (E MN : Type -> Type) (op : Monoid.Monoid W) (w : W),
       @Writer.writer_handler W E MN op unit
         (@Sum.inl1 (Writer.writerE W) E unit (@Writer.Tell W w)) =
       {|
         PTreeDefinition._observe :=
           @PTreeDefinition.VisF (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE W) E) MN unit
             (PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE W) E) MN unit) W
             (@Sum.inl1 (State.stateE W) E W (State.Get W))
             (fun log : W =>
              {|
                PTreeDefinition._observe :=
                  @PTreeDefinition.VisF (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE W) E) MN unit
                    (PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE W) E) MN unit) unit
                    (@Sum.inl1 (State.stateE W) E unit
                       (State.Put W (@Monoid.monoid_plus W op log w)))
                    (fun _ : unit =>
                     {|
                       PTreeDefinition._observe :=
                         @PTreeDefinition.RetF (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE W) E) MN unit
                           (PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE W) E) MN unit) tt
                     |})
              |})
       |}
